targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS namespace, count() AS lines FROM {{ .Values.database }}.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, namespace ORDER BY time

panels.title: Traefik requests: 5xx or slower than 1 s
panels.description: JSON access logs of traefik-internal and traefik-external (Duration is in nanoseconds).

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, JSONExtractString(Body, 'RequestHost') AS host, JSONExtractString(Body, 'RequestMethod') AS method, JSONExtractString(Body, 'RequestPath') AS path, JSONExtractInt(Body, 'DownstreamStatus') AS status, round(JSONExtractFloat(Body, 'Duration') / 1e6) AS duration_ms, JSONExtractString(Body, 'ServiceName') AS backend FROM {{ .Values.database }}.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'traefik' AND JSONHas(Body, 'DownstreamStatus') AND (JSONExtractInt(Body, 'DownstreamStatus') >= 500 OR JSONExtractFloat(Body, 'Duration') > 1e9) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, Body AS body, SeverityText AS level, ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS namespace, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container FROM {{ .Values.database }}.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${namespace:singlequote}) AND positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '${search}') > 0 ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000
